thread:
Maya K: FYI — bringup of qbringup-2b-int4 on the latency cluster shows a quality dip for longform prompts (>=1500 tokens). Not a throughput issue, looks like truncation or KV-cache mismatch. Can we prioritize adding longform golden examples + a small labeler run?
Ram: ack. can you paste the failing examples / quick diffs?
Maya K: Pasted a few below. model vs baseline (squad-style):
```
- baseline: answer includes full multi-paragraph reasoning
- q2b-int4: cuts off mid-sentence, hallucinates an unrelated date
metrics: EM drop 13.2 pts, Rouge-L -9.6
```
Oliver: hmm that smells like a quant edgecase on attention kernel selection for long sequences. We recently swapped kernel B for seq>1024 to reduce mem. Could be a perf vs correctness tradeoff.
Emily: tagging curation: we should add 40 longform anchors to the golden set (diverse domains) and a 200-sample labeler batch for quick regression. Labeler-Ops-Bot can we schedule that?
Labeler-Ops-Bot: got it — creating batch. Sampling query: `SELECT id, prompt FROM prompt_bank WHERE token_count > 1500 AND source IN ('web','support') ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 200;` confirm?
Maya K: confirm. Prefer en+multi punctuation variants, include some code blocks and dialogue.
Ram: also suggest adding automated canary eval that runs the new kernel on these 40 anchors and compares top-3 completions (bleu/roge/credence) before we promote. Quick script suggestion: `./canary_eval --model qbringup-2b-int4 --anchors anchors_long.json --threshold 0.85`
Oliver: I'm going to roll back kernel B on a small canary host and re-run the failing items. If rollback removes the regression we pin kernel selection behind a feature-flag.
Emily: on labeling side — do we need new labeling instructions? For longform we should ask labelers to mark truncation/hallucination explicitly and attach the expected tail. Add this to the quick-guide: `Longform: mark \"truncated\" if last sentence incomplete; mark \"hallucination\" if invented facts.`
Maya K: good. Also we found a tiny duplicate cluster (~6%) between the longform sample and existing golden set. Can curation please dedupe before anchor commit. CLI: `curate dedupe --cohort longform --threshold 0.95`
Labeler-Ops-Bot: dedupe job queued, will output `anchors_long.json` to /s3/curation/canary/ by EOD. Batch scheduled for tomorrow morning PST.
Ram: thanks. next steps summary: 1) Oliver rollbacks kernel B on canary + run the anchors, 2) Maya/Emily finalize 40 anchors + labeling instructions, 3) labeler batch runs and outputs QC, 4) canary eval compares baseline vs q2b-int4 on anchors. Ping in this thread when any step completes. :thumbsup:
